note: Deferred scoring reference only. No scoring is computed during data collection.
collection_phase: runs.jsonl records contain raw response text. No keyword scores, no LLM scores.

nested_schema.timestamp_utc: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at API call completion.

model.vendor: Vendor name as in models config.
model.label: Human-readable model label.

request.prompt: Exact user-facing prompt text sent to model.
request.prompt_sha256: SHA-256 hex digest of prompt for deduplication and integrity.

response.text: Raw completion text, stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.
response.raw: Full API response object as returned by OpenRouter.

usage.cost_usd: Float or null. From OpenRouter usage.cost if provided.
usage.latency_ms: Integer. Wall-clock ms from request send to response received.

error_schema.error_type: network_timeout | http_error_4xx | http_error_5xx | rate_limit | invalid_model | unavailable_model | json_decode_error | malformed_response | provider_error | unknown
error_schema.error_detail: String. Exception message or HTTP response body.
